title: Billing Office Schedule: Invoicing Basis, Payment Terms and Late Charges for Catering
content:
## Invoicing and payment figures by service level

Six figures are printed against each service level of the Corporate Catering Service Agreement. The first two say how catering invoices are grouped and, where they are grouped monthly, on which day of the month the invoice is raised. The remaining four govern payment: the calendar days from invoice date within which payment is due, the monthly late charge on an overdue catering invoice as a percentage of the overdue amount, the calendar days past the due date before a late charge may be raised, and the ceiling on the late charge raised against one catering invoice.

| Service level | Invoice grouping | Invoice day of month | Payment terms | Monthly late charge | Grace days | Late charge ceiling |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Drop-Off Catering Account | per order | 1 | 15 days | 1.5 per cent | 3 | 250.00 USD |
| Delivered Buffet Account | per order | 5 | 21 days | 1.5 per cent | 5 | 600.00 USD |
| Attended Buffet Account | weekly | 10 | 30 days | 1.25 per cent | 7 | 1400.00 USD |
| Staffed Full-Service Catering Account | weekly | 15 | 30 days | 1.25 per cent | 7 | 3200.00 USD |
| Executive Hospitality Catering Account | monthly | 20 | 45 days | 1.0 per cent | 10 | 4500.00 USD |
| Campus Catering Master Account | monthly | 25 | 45 days | 1.0 per cent | 10 | 7500.00 USD |

The monthly late charge falls as the service level rises, from 1.5 per cent down to 1.0 per cent, while the ceiling on that charge rises from 250.00 USD to 7500.00 USD; the grace days rise with it, from 3 days to 10.
